title: An underwater adventure joins the showcase
summary:
A new underwater text adventure joined the showcase, while three website sections traded background images for solid colors.

Abyss Ascending, @brain.diver’s web-based generative text adventure set in a sci-fi underwater world, was added to the README and creative-app showcase.

The community, team, and supporter sections now use solid-color backgrounds in place of images. Their gradients remain unchanged, and eight unused image assets were removed.
